pages.title: Yoshi Waving Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi waves in this printable coloring page, lifting a large open hand beside his smiling face while standing on broad cuffed shoes above a curved ground line. His rounded snout, tall eyes, back spikes, saddle, and pointed tail fill the portrait, with a spotted mushroom and rounded hill behind him.

pages.title: Yoshi with Tongue Out Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi sticks his tongue out in this printable coloring page, extending its long curled tip from an open mouth below his large snout and tall eyes. The close portrait also shows rounded back spikes, a segmented saddle, small hands, a curved belly outline, and part of his pointed tail.

pages.title: Mario and Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario and Yoshi stand together in this printable coloring page, smiling side by side while Mario rests one gloved hand around Yoshi's shoulder beneath his large rounded snout. Mario's M cap, mustache, and buttoned overalls contrast with Yoshi's back spikes, saddle, spotted tail, and broad cuffed shoes.

pages.title: Yoshi Hatching From an Egg Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi hatches from an egg in this printable coloring page, rising above the jagged rim with one small fist raised beside his large snout and smiling mouth. Round spots cover the broken shell, and a detached shell section rests in front of him near a small plant.

pages.title: Rabbid Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Rabbid Yoshi grins in this printable coloring page, standing with bent arms beside his belly while two tall rabbit ears rise above his oversized eyes and snout. Two prominent front teeth, a wide open mouth, a small saddle, and large cuffed shoes appear amid curls, dots, and motion marks.

pages.title: Halloween Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi dresses for Halloween in this printable coloring page, wearing a tall buckled witch hat while holding the handle of a pumpkin-shaped treat bucket with both hands. Small sweets fill the bucket beside his saddle and rounded snout, with three flying bats and a separate pumpkin surrounding him.

pages.title: Pixel Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Pixel Yoshi stands in this printable coloring page, with stepped black outlines shaping his oversized snout, tall eyes, rounded belly, and large shoes against a plain background. The blocky edge pattern continues around his small clenched hands, back spikes, saddle, and pointed tail in a full-length retro portrait.

pages.title: Mario Luigi and Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario, Luigi, and Yoshi pose together in this printable coloring page, with the two brothers standing in front while Yoshi's large smiling face rises between their lettered caps. Gloves, buttoned overalls, rounded shoes, Yoshi's small hands, and two simple clouds complete the closely arranged group portrait.

pages.title: Yoshi and Toad Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi and Toad stand side by side in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath soft cloud shapes with their rounded shoes resting on a simple curved ground line. Yoshi's large snout, saddle, back spikes, and tail contrast with Toad's wide spotted mushroom cap, open vest, and small lowered hands.

pages.title: Yoshi's Island with Baby Mario Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Mario rides Yoshi in this Yoshi's Island printable coloring page, sitting barefoot on the small saddle and holding near Yoshi's neck beneath an oversized M cap. Rounded hills and clouds surround the pair, with Yoshi's large snout, small fists, pointed tail, and cuffed shoes shown in full.

pages.title: Yoshi with a Mushroom Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi holds a mushroom in this printable coloring page, smiling behind its round spotted cap while supporting its small stem and oval eyes with both hands. His tall eyes, rounded snout, back spikes, curved belly, and small saddle fill the close portrait against a plain open background.

pages.title: Baby Yoshi Hatching From an Egg Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Yoshi hatches from an egg in this printable coloring page, resting both small hands on the jagged shell rim while looking upward with a gentle smile. Large round spots and branching cracks cover the shell, with tiny toes, pointed leaves, grass blades, and an irregular shadow below.

pages.title: Yoshi with an Egg Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi holds an egg in this printable coloring page, wrapping both hands around its large spotted shell while smiling beneath his oversized snout and tall eyes. His small saddle, pointed tail, back spikes, and thick cuffed shoes appear against rounded bushes, a ground line, and two cloud outlines.

pages.title: Yoshi with Baby Mario Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi carries Baby Mario in this printable coloring page, stepping forward with one large shoe lifted while the smiling baby rides on the small saddle behind his neck. Baby Mario's oversized M cap and tiny shoes appear beneath scattered stars, clouds, and a sun with short triangular rays.

pages.title: Yoshi on a Motorcycle Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi rides a motorcycle in this printable coloring page, holding both handlebars while sitting above the exposed engine with his broad shoe resting beside the frame. Spoked wheels, knobby tires, curved fenders, and a rear exhaust add mechanical detail beneath his saddle, with small grass tufts and clouds nearby.

pages.title: Easy Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi smiles in this easy printable coloring page, shown in a close portrait inside a large oval frame with his rounded snout and tall eyes facing forward. Thick outlines define his small hands, back spikes, saddle, and pointed tail, with simple clouds and a spotted rounded hill behind him.

pages.title: Cute Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Cute Yoshi stands in this printable coloring page, holding his small hands near his belly while smiling beneath a large rounded snout and tall oval eyes. A rectangular border frames his saddle, back spikes, pointed tail, and cuffed shoes, with clouds and low rounded bushes in the background.

pages.title: Yoshi Catching Fruit with His Tongue Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi catches fruit with his tongue in this printable coloring page, stretching its curled tip beneath a large apple while looking upward with an open mouth. A leaf and stem top the fruit, with pointed bushes, a spotted mushroom, grass tufts, and Yoshi's broad shoes below.

pages.title: Black Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Black Yoshi stands in this printable coloring page, smiling with his hands lowered beside his rounded belly while his large snout and tall eyes face forward. His small saddle, back spikes, pointed tail, and thick cuffed shoes appear against rolling ground, low bushes, and simple cloud shapes.

pages.title: Paper Yoshi with Baby Mario Coloring Page
pages.description: Paper Yoshi carries Baby Mario in this printable coloring page, lifting both broad shoes forward while the smiling baby sits on the small saddle behind his neck. Bold outlines define Yoshi's round snout, small fists, and tail beside Baby Mario's M cap, gloved hands, overalls, and tiny shoes.

pages.title: Yoshi Jumping Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi jumps in this printable coloring page, spreading both hands beside his smiling face while one large shoe kicks forward above a curved line of ground. Clouds surround his oversized snout, tall eyes, small saddle, and pointed tail, with rounded bushes filling the lower part of the scene.

pages.title: Baby Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Yoshi stands in this printable coloring page, holding both hands open beside a rounded belly covered with large circular spots beneath his smiling face. His small bare feet and spotted tail sit below a segmented saddle, while tall eyes, a broad snout, and back spikes complete the simple portrait.

pages.title: Baby Mario Riding Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Mario rides Yoshi in this printable coloring page, waving one small hand from the saddle while wearing an oversized M cap and buttoned overalls above tiny shoes. Yoshi stands beneath him with a rounded snout, small hands, back spikes, and cuffed shoes, backed by clouds and tall rounded hills.

pages.title: Yoshi and Princess Peach Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi stands beside Princess Peach in this printable coloring page, with his tall eyes and rounded snout level with her crowned head in a close paired portrait. Peach's necklace, oval brooch, puffed sleeves, and draped skirt panels appear beside Yoshi's spotted body, small saddle, back spikes, and lowered hand.

pages.title: Yoshi Driving a Kart Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi drives a kart in this printable coloring page, sitting with both hands on the wheel while his large cuffed shoes rest above the exposed frame. The small vehicle has treaded tires, circular spoke patterns, a tubular front bumper, an angled exhaust, and an engine behind his saddle.

pages.title: Happy Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Happy Yoshi spreads his arms in this printable coloring page, smiling with an open mouth beneath his large rounded snout while standing against a plain background. His small saddle, back spikes, curved belly, and pointed tail lead down to broad cuffed boots, including one with a square buckle.

pages.title: Yoshi Eating Fruit Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi eats fruit in this printable coloring page, bringing an apple toward his open mouth with one hand while the other hangs beside his rounded belly. The apple's leaf, stem, and oval highlight appear beside his broad snout, tall eyes, back spikes, small saddle, and pointed tail.

pages.title: Yoshi Standing and Smiling Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi stands and smiles in this printable coloring page, keeping both hands low beside his rounded belly while his wide snout and tall eyes face forward. Spots decorate the small saddle on his back, with rounded spikes, a pointed tail, and thick cuffed shoes above a short ground line.

pages.title: Yoshi Carrying Mario Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi carries Mario in this printable coloring page, stepping forward with one large shoe raised while Mario waves from the saddle beneath his lettered M cap. Mario's gloves, mustache, and buttoned overalls rise above Yoshi's rounded snout, small bent arms, back spikes, and long pointed tail.

pages.title: Yoshi Throwing an Egg Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi throws an egg in this printable coloring page, extending one open hand toward the airborne spotted shell while raising a large shoe in front of him. Short speed lines trace the egg's path beside his smiling face, with a clenched free hand, small saddle, and sweeping tail below.

pages.title: Yoshi Riding Poochy Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi rides Poochy in this printable coloring page, waving one hand while sitting above Poochy's back and holding a curved strap with his other hand. Poochy bounds forward with floppy ears, broad paws, an open smiling mouth, a raised tail, and a collar bearing a bone-shaped tag.

pages.title: Yoshi Eating Watermelon Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi eats watermelon in this printable coloring page, holding a broad crescent-shaped slice with both hands beneath his smiling mouth and large rounded snout in a close portrait. A scalloped bite breaks the upper edge above teardrop seeds and a double-lined rind, with his saddle visible behind one arm.

pages.title: Angry Baby Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Angry Baby Yoshi clenches both fists in this printable coloring page, frowning beneath sharply slanted brows while his large snout fills the center of the close portrait. Tall eyes, rounded back spikes, a small saddle, and part of his pointed tail appear against clouds and low bush outlines.

pages.title: Super Mario Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi from Super Mario stands in this printable coloring page, holding both hands near his rounded belly while smiling beneath a broad snout and tall oval eyes. Small clouds and low rounded bushes surround his back spikes, saddle, pointed tail, and thick cuffed shoes above a straight ground line.

pages.title: Yoshi Racing with Mario Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi races with Mario in this printable coloring page, driving side by side in small go-karts while both grip their steering wheels and smile along the course. Their individual emblems decorate the karts' nose panels above tubular bumpers, with broad tires, rear exhausts, distant hills, and a cloud.

pages.title: Yoshi Flying Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi flies in this printable coloring page, hovering with his broad shoes together while a pair of feathered wings rises from the small saddle on his back. Short curved marks show the wings flapping beside his rounded snout, tall eyes, and lowered hands, with clouds and distant hills below.

pages.title: Yoshi Holding an Egg Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi holds an egg in this printable coloring page, supporting its broad spotted shell with both hands beside his rounded belly and large, gently smiling snout. A circular cheek outline and oval eye shapes add detail to the portrait, alongside back spikes, a segmented saddle, and a pointed tail.

pages.title: Yoshi Eating an Apple Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi eats an apple in this printable coloring page, closing his eyes in a smile while holding the bitten fruit between both hands below his large rounded snout. A short stem and pointed leaf top the apple, with his back spikes, small saddle, and sweeping tail visible behind him.

pages.title: Mario Kart Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi drives in Mario Kart in this printable coloring page, wearing a rounded helmet and goggles while holding the steering wheel above his broad, forward-facing shoes. The kart's tubular front bumper, thick smooth tires, exposed steering shaft, and angled rear exhaust appear among clouds and large cropped circular shapes.

pages.title: Yoshi Flutter Jumping Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi performs a flutter jump in this printable coloring page, spreading his open hands while one large shoe kicks forward and the other hangs beneath his rounded body. A looping dashed trail curls below him, with a small saddle, pointed tail, tall eyes, and a wide smile completing the airborne pose.

pages.title: Cute Baby Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Cute Baby Yoshi waves in this printable coloring page, lifting one small open hand beside his smiling face while standing barefoot beneath an oversized rounded snout. Tall outlined eyes, a circular cheek patch, back spikes, a small saddle, and a pointed tail define his compact figure against an open background.

pages.title: Yoshi and Birdo Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi and Birdo stand together in this printable coloring page, with Yoshi smiling beside Birdo as she lifts one hand toward the cheek beneath her tall bow. Their rounded snouts, back spikes, and tails contrast with Yoshi's broad shoes, Birdo's small claws, and the low bushes behind them.

pages.title: Kawaii Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Kawaii Yoshi holds a small leafy stem in this printable coloring page, smiling with wide eyes while clasping the plant between both hands beneath his oversized snout. Two pointed leaves show central veins beside his curved belly, with rounded back spikes and a patterned saddle completing the close portrait.

pages.title: Yoshi's Woolly World Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi's Woolly World appears in this printable coloring page through a standing Yoshi covered in dense rows of interlocking knitted stitch patterns from snout to shoes. His tall eyes, smooth cheek, small saddle, and back spikes interrupt the textured outlines, with rounded hills and clouds in the simple landscape behind him.

pages.title: Christmas Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Christmas Yoshi smiles in this printable coloring page, holding an oversized striped candy cane with both hands while wearing a long Santa hat and a fringed scarf. The hat's round pompom hangs beside his back spikes, above a small saddle, pointed tail, rounded belly, and broad cuffed shoes.

pages.title: Yoshi with Shy Guys Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi stands with Shy Guys in this printable coloring page, smiling at the center while two small hooded figures flank his saddle and rounded belly. Their masks have oval eye openings and small round mouths above belts and broad shoes, with simple clouds and tall rounded hills behind the group.

pages.title: Mario Riding Yoshi Coloring Page
pages.description: Mario rides Yoshi in this printable coloring page, holding reins near Yoshi's neck while sitting on the saddle beneath his M cap and smiling mustached face. Yoshi steps forward with one cuffed shoe raised, backed by a low hill, a small cloud, and a sun with short straight rays.

pages.title: Yoshi and Luigi Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi and Luigi stand together in this printable coloring page, smiling side by side with their hands lowered and broad shoes aligned against a plain open background. Luigi's L cap, mustache, gloves, and buttoned overalls appear beside Yoshi's rounded snout, tall eyes, small saddle, back spikes, and pointed tail.

pages.title: Yoshi with Eggs Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi holds an egg beside three more eggs in this printable coloring page, supporting its plain oval shell with both hands beneath his gently smiling rounded snout. The cluster rests near his cuffed shoes, with his saddle, pointed tail, rolling hills, and a few small clouds behind him.

pages.title: Yoshi Running Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi runs in this printable coloring page, pumping his bent arms and stretching one large shoe forward while the other leg reaches behind his rounded body. His open smile, tall eyes, small saddle, back spikes, and sweeping tail appear above sparse grass tufts and short lines marking the ground.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Running in Flower Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi runs through the Flower Kingdom with Mario in this printable coloring page, carrying him on the saddle while both smile along a winding stony path. Large round-petaled flowers and grass tufts line the route beneath rolling hills, small trees, clouds, and a round sun near the horizon.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Pointing in Sky Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi points through the Sky Kingdom with Mario in this printable coloring page, extending one finger while Mario waves from the saddle above Yoshi's airborne shoes. A question block and mushroom sit on a floating ledge, with small rocky islands, a tiny castle, and scattered clouds around the pair.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Looking Around in Sandy Desert Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi looks around a sandy desert with Mario in this printable coloring page, walking along a winding path while Mario sits on his saddle with a round mouth. Ribbed cacti and prickly pear pads rise among scattered rocks, layered dunes, and low clouds behind Yoshi's large snout and raised shoe.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Exploring in Amusement Park Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi explores an amusement park with Mario in this printable coloring page, carrying him along a curving path while Mario raises a gloved hand in a wave. A Ferris wheel, looping roller coaster, carousel horses, lamp post, and arrow sign fill the park behind the smiling pair.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Exploring in Desert Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi explores the Desert Kingdom with Mario in this printable coloring page, stepping along a winding trail while Mario waves from the saddle beneath his M cap. Tall cacti and scattered rocks border the route, with a pyramid, domed buildings, dunes, and a palm-lined pool in the distance.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Resting In Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi rests in a tower with Mario in this printable coloring page, sitting beside him on a curved stone ledge within a broad arched opening in the wall. Their shoes extend forward beneath relaxed hands and smiling faces, with block outlines, pointed mountains, and clouds around the small scene.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Resting By River Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi rests by a river with Mario in this printable coloring page, reclining on the grassy bank while Mario sits beside him with both legs stretched forward. Their relaxed faces and broad shoes appear above the winding water, with river stones, low bushes, distant hills, and clouds behind them.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Watching In Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi watches at a castle with Mario in this printable coloring page, standing beside him in front of the tall arched gate beneath three pointed towers. Brick-patterned walls and square battlements surround the pair's lowered hands and broad shoes, with grass tufts, rounded hills, clouds, and a circular sun nearby.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Reaching In Grassy Field Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi reaches across a grassy field with Mario in this printable coloring page, stretching both hands forward while Mario spreads his gloved arms wide behind him. A large outlined circle and small clouds appear above Yoshi's smiling snout, with a segmented saddle and grass tufts across the rolling ground.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Looking Around In Storage Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi looks around a storage room with Mario in this printable coloring page, tilting his head upward beside Mario amid stacks of open and sealed boxes. Shelves hold assorted tools, containers, and small blocks beneath a round window, with loose cubes and a wrench scattered near their shoes.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Running In Finish Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi runs through a finish area with Mario in this printable coloring page, lifting a broad shoe as both pass behind a wide checkered finish ribbon. Two tall flagpoles, scattered stars, palm trees, and a domed castle tower frame the pair's smiling faces and forward-moving legs.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Standing Calmly In Ocean Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi stands calmly in the ocean with Mario in this printable coloring page, keeping his hands lowered beside his belly as small ripples circle their broad shoes. Gentle wave lines and round bubbles fill the water, with low islands, leaning palm trees, and a sun sending straight rays above the horizon.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Watching In Coin Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi watches in a coin room with Mario in this printable coloring page, looking upward beside him amid high stacks of coins and falling individual pieces. A large question block hangs beneath an arched opening between columns, while circular floor patterns and loose coins surround the pair's shoes.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Standing Confidently In Snow Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi stands confidently in a snow level with Mario in this printable coloring page, opening both hands while Mario rests his gloved hands at his hips. Round snowflakes fall around their smiling faces and broad shoes, with pointed evergreen trees across smooth rolling snowbanks behind them.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Walking In Block Area Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi walks through a block area with Mario in this printable coloring page, following him across large dotted cubes beneath floating question blocks inside a double rectangular border. Their raised shoes and bent arms break the blocks' straight outlines, with small clouds and rounded bushes in the background.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Running In Treasure Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi runs through a treasure room with Mario in this printable coloring page, leading him between open chests and piles of stacked coins while both smile. A faceted hanging ornament, tall fluted columns, arched windows, exposed wall blocks, and scattered gems add smaller details around their moving feet.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Walking In Course Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi walks along a course with Mario in this printable coloring page, following his raised shoe across a row of broad platforms with large corner studs. A short pipe, two spotted mushrooms, rounded banded hills, and simple clouds appear behind their smiling faces, Mario's cap, and Yoshi's saddle.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Walking Slowly On Pathway Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi walks slowly along a pathway with Mario in this printable coloring page, stepping beside him across oval paving stones as both smile beneath rounded cloud shapes. Large flowers and low bushes border the winding route toward a spotted mushroom house with an arched door, window, and chimney.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Posing Proudly Near A Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi poses proudly near a castle with Mario in this printable coloring page, raising one fist while resting his other hand at his hip beside Mario's matching pose. Pointed towers, arched windows, brick details, and rounded shrubs rise behind them, with small clouds and a double-outlined circle overhead.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Playing Happily In A Cave Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi plays happily in a cave level with Mario in this printable coloring page, carrying him through an arched passage while Mario spreads both hands above his smiling face. Their raised shoes pass over a cracked boulder, with hanging stalactites, pointed floor formations, and a spotted mushroom framing the jump.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Standing Bravely On A Sunny Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi stands bravely on a sunny hill with Mario in this printable coloring page, smiling beside him beneath a large sun with a friendly face and pointed rays. A small flag-topped castle appears behind Yoshi's shoes, with clouds, flowers, and grass tufts around the pair's proud stance.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Waving Happily In A Bright Adventure Land Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi waves happily in a bright adventure land with Mario in this printable coloring page, lifting one open hand beside Mario's raised glove on a curving stone path. A spotted mushroom house, leafy tree, rounded hills, and small clouds fill the landscape beneath a large sun with long outlined rays.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Looking Excited In A Desert Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi looks excited in a desert level with Mario in this printable coloring page, stretching both arms wide while Mario raises his fists and one knee beside him. Tall ribbed cacti, low dunes, and scattered stones frame their open smiles beneath small clouds and a sun with short straight rays.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Spinning Happily Near A Castle Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi spins happily near a castle with Mario in this printable coloring page, with two Yoshi figures forming a circle around Mario amid sweeping curved motion lines. Their open hands and lifted shoes fill the foreground beneath a flag-topped castle, banded hills, a small cloud, and a pointed sun.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Climbing Happily In A Flower Field Coloring Page
Mario Yoshi Posing Proudly In A Fantasy Land Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi poses proudly in a fantasy land with Mario in this printable coloring page, resting one foot on an angular rock while both hold their hands at their hips. Spotted mushrooms and low bushes dot the hills behind them beneath a distant turreted castle and small spiral-ended clouds.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Sitting Peacefully In A Bright Adventure Land Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi sits peacefully in a bright adventure land with Mario in this printable coloring page, resting beside him with their broad shoes stretched forward among tall flowers. A winding path leads back to a spotted mushroom house, with leafy trees, rounded bushes, clouds, and a banded mountain completing the landscape.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Standing Proudly In A Cave Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi stands proudly in a cave level with Mario in this printable coloring page, keeping one hand at his hip while Mario smiles and rests an arm behind him. Stalactites, angular rocks, floating blocks, scattered pebbles, and broad leaves surround the pair beside a winding cave path.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Posing Proudly In A Magical World Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi poses proudly in a magical world with Mario in this printable coloring page, folding his arms while Mario stands beside him with hands resting at his hips. A large spotted mushroom house rises behind them, with a smoking chimney, low bushes, and a winding path toward a distant castle.

pages.title: Mario Yoshi Climbing Happily in a Cave Level Coloring Page
pages.description: Yoshi climbs happily through a cave level with Mario in this printable coloring page, following Mario up a steep rocky slope as he waves one gloved hand overhead. Stalactites hang above their raised shoes, while patterned rounded formations, a floating mushroom, and an outlined coin appear within the angular cavern.
